notes.title: Sneaky Peeky
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! I am here to give you an update/leak on the new game, Communist Clicker 2. It will feature new things like quests, a story mode, a way to beat the game possibly, and much more. Stay tuned for more future updates on Communist Clicker 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41651706/c70a7744e945c5bf1209ef1032c3aa889d2bcf75.png[/img]

notes.title: Spoiler Alert! & QnA
notes.content:
Hello everyone! You haven't heard from me in a while due to me taking the summer off, but I've secretly started working on Communist Clicker 2! I'll link a spoiler of the main menu in this post, and in the comments you can feel free to ask any questions you want about the upcoming Communist Clicker 2. We will also be taking into consideration any suggestions for the game that you all can leave in the comments as well. Enjoy the rest of the weekend!

- TheGamer982

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41651706/0ff1be663922be74b2d96873710fa38f382fd36c.png[/img]

notes.title: Technical Difficulties :(
notes.content: Sadly, we are having technical difficulties with the new update. For unknown reasons the new build is not working, and the game keeps reverting to the old version whenever I try to upload the new one. MacOS experimental support may still work, but none of the other previously mentioned features will work.

notes.title: Ear Protection
notes.content:
Added:
- Music toggle on/off button in the gameplay menu.
- Experimental support for MacOS users.
Changed:
- Stonks now have a higher chance to increase in price.
- Nukes have a negative impact on the stonks market.
- The "Crash Stonks Market" item in the black market now has a greater impact on the stonks market.
- Nukes improve stats like workers, effort, and clicks.

notes.title: A challenger approaches... maybe...
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day everyone! Somewhere in the future, we hope to make a sequel to Communist Clicker. We are debating whether we should call it Communist Clicker 2, Capitalist Clicker, or even make a completely new game or series. What do you think?
